values.note: For 2026, half the sites book online and half are first-come; the whole campground is first-come early and late in the season. First-come sites pay by cash or check only. Reservations can't be modified.

note: Medicine Bow NF campground at about 10,700 ft, one of the highest in the country, 3/4 mile north of WY-130 on FR 346 (about 40 miles west of Laramie). Single loop on an open hillside with little shade and views of the Snowy Range; Libby and Lewis Lakes and three trailheads are close by (carry-in boats only). Hand-pump water roughly July to September; bring water. Acclimate if coming from low elevation. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov + catalog read: 16 sites, 22-ft trailer limit with tight roads and small sites (passes under the 22-ft ruling - flag), vault toilet, hand-pump water Jul-Sep, no hookups, $20 (cash/check on site), 8 people, 14 days. 2026 mix of reservable and FCFS sites (some_sites). Season written 06-22..10-10 (rec.gov). Not waterfront holds (Libby Lake ~200 m). Phone confirmed. Pin fine. policy_ref missing.
